{{Classes used for Sailing at the Summer Olympics|year = 2004}}

The '''Mixed 49er''' was a sailing event on the [[Sailing at the 2004 Summer Olympics]] program in [[Agios Kosmas Olympic Sailing Centre]].<ref name="A" /> sixteen races were scheduled and completed with two discards. 38 sailors, on 19 boats, from 19 nation competed.<ref name="Scoring_System" /><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/11159 |title=Sailing at the 2004 Summer Olympics: Skiff (49er), Open |work=Olympedia |access-date=29 June 2020}}</ref>
